_meta.description: Grouped Process summing revenue by month on orders.pulse decorated with an OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_ROLLING_MEAN group overlay: each month against the mean of the 3 months before it (params.window 3), point / rolling_mean * 100. A point needs params.min_periods earlier present points (1 to the window, default the window) and is null before that, with no warning, so the first three months are null. A zero rolling mean emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO. Sibling of OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_ROLLING (22_process_zscore_vs_rolling.json). Buffered; renderers centre colour ramps on baseline 100.
_meta.name: process-index-vs-rolling-mean
